name: git-integration-operations-cli
description: > Automate the Microsoft Fabric Git integration lifecycle from CLI environments using the Fabric CLI (fab api), with az rest as a fallback. Use when the user wants to connect a workspace to Azure DevOps or GitHub, commit or update/pull workspace items, check Git sync status, resolve update conflicts, disconnect, automate Git sync with a service principal, or link a branch workspace to its base. Do NOT use for branch switching, for deployment tools (fab deploy, fabric-cicd, Bulk Import), for depl
author: microsoft
summary_zh: 用于在命令行自动管理 Microsoft Fabric 与 Azure DevOps 或 GitHub 的连接、同步、冲突处理及服务主体集成。
